# FAA Flight Logs

Directory: `C:\Sovereign\AE-Hub\data\faa\`

## Purpose
Stores FAA-compliant flight logs, Part 107 certification records, airspace checks, and BVLOS waiver documentation.

## Subdirectories
- `raw/` — Raw flight log JSON files ingested from UAV fleet
- `validated/` — Logs that have passed `faa_compliance.py` validation
- `waivers/` — BVLOS and other FAA waiver documentation

## Generated by
- `modules/faa_compliance.py`

## Retention
90 days per governance.json
